controls.title: Disable SSH password authentication
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms passwordauthentication=yes; Lynis SSH-7408 present

controls.title: Disable direct SSH root login
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms permitrootlogin=yes; Lynis SSH-7408 present

controls.title: Restrict SSH access to an explicit allowed-users list
controls.evidence: Lynis SSH-7408 present (generic SSH hardening); baseline shows allowusers=not-set

controls.title: Enforce password quality requirements via pam_pwquality
controls.evidence: Lynis flags adjacent password-policy items (AUTH-9230/9282/9286/9328), not the pwquality module specifically

controls.title: Enable account lockout via pam_faillock after repeated failed logins
controls.evidence: No Lynis finding or baseline data addresses account lockout specifically

controls.title: Restrict core dumps (fs.suid_dumpable=0)
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms fs.suid_dumpable=2 (should be 0); Lynis KRNL-5820 present

controls.title: Reject ICMP redirects
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects=0, the secure value

controls.title: Disable IP forwarding
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 on a database/web server with no routing function

controls.title: Enable TCP SYN cookies
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies=1, the secure value (Ubuntu default)

controls.title: Identify and remove unauthorized SUID binaries
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms 2 non-standard SUID binaries outside typical package paths (/usr/local, /opt)

controls.title: Apply noexec, nosuid, and nodev mount options to non-system partitions
controls.evidence: No baseline or Lynis confirmation exists; evidence basis is documented Ubuntu 22.04 default behavior (these mount options are not applied out of the box), not scan data

controls.title: Disable or remove unnecessary network-facing services
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms 28 running services on billing-srv-01; no formal approved-services allow-list exists to confirm which are justified

controls.title: Restrict MySQL to localhost-only binding and enforce default-deny host firewall
controls.evidence: Baseline confirms MySQL bound to 0.0.0.0:3306; Lynis FIRE-4512 confirms iptables loaded with no active rules; FIRE-4513 confirms unused rule review needed

controls.title: Deploy auditd rules for privilege escalation and sensitive file modification
controls.evidence: Lynis ACCT-9630 directly confirms: audit daemon is enabled with an empty ruleset

controls.title: Configure remote log forwarding and enforce log file write-protection
controls.evidence: Lynis LOGG-2154 directly confirms: no external logging host currently configured
